Overview

This run searched GCF_000260355.1_ConCri1.0_genomic.fna with 8 subfamily consensuses from tala.bnk. After merging overlapping hits across queries, 471,321 candidate SINE copies entered step2. Of those, 390,298 (82.8%) were unanimously called by all 10 sub-samples, 387,049 (82.1%) passed the bitscore threshold and received a final subfamily label, and 84,272 (17.9%) remained unassigned.

Detailed numbers are in the Funnel, Assignment and Composition sections below.

Subfamily composition

Source: summary.by_subfam.tsv. Combines firm vs soft assignments with sanity-check leak/conflict counts and similarity statistics.

Column legend
  • subfam — Subfamily name.
  • firm_assigned — Copies whose primary assignment uses 10/10 votes and passed the threshold (high-confidence).
  • soft_assigned — Copies promoted via soft-rules (ssearch36 tie-breaking on otherwise-unassigned).
  • total_assigned — firm_assigned + soft_assigned.
  • leak_n — Copies of OTHER subfamilies that, in step3 sanity checks, leaked into this subfamily's intervals.
  • conf_alt_n — Genomic intervals where this subfamily is the winning name but at least one other subfamily also had hits (CONFLICT-flagged).
  • firm_pct — firm_assigned as % of all firm assignments.
  • total_pct — total_assigned as % of all assignments.
  • leak_pct — leak_n as % of total_assigned.
  • conf_alt_pct — conf_alt_n as % of total_assigned.
  • sim_mean — Mean per-copy bitscore / consensus self-bits.
  • sim_median — Median per-copy bitscore / consensus self-bits.

Divergence from consensus — per copy

Metric: bitscore-based divergence = 100 − (copy bitscore / consensus self-bitscore × 100 %). This is a proxy for sequence divergence, not a direct nucleotide count. Values are clamped to 0 where local alignment scores exceed the consensus self-bitscore. The histogram is built from the real step2 plots/data/pctid_<subfam>.tsv files (up to 10,000 copies per subfamily), grouped into 1 percentage-point divergence bins; bar height is copy count. Colors show subfamilies; click legend entries to toggle.

Distributions per subfamily (violin)

Same report source data shown as similarity distributions. Width encodes density; inner box = IQR; dashed line = mean.

Sources: divergence uses plots/data/pctid_<subfam>.tsv; violin uses sim_scores.tsv joined with assignment_full.tsv.

Per-position conservation

For each subfamily, the y-value at consensus position i is the fraction of assigned copies that carry the consensus base at that position (from the MAFFT pairwise alignments produced by step4). Click subfamily names in the legend to toggle traces.

Source: plots/data/<subfam>_nucfreq.tsv (written by the patched step4_plots.sh + plot_subfamily.py).

PCA — SINEplot layout

External visualisation by SINEplot. Each copy is positioned in 2D using MDS over the all-vs-all bitscore matrix of (consensuses + a stratified sample of assigned copies). Copies are coloured by best-matching subfamily; opacity encodes confidence; a Conflict mode highlights ambiguous assignments.

Step2 — assignments per subfamily

Output of step2_asSINEment.sh stored in assignment_stats.tsv. Assigned is the number of SINE copies that received a final, threshold-passing label of this subfamily.

Column legend
  • Subfamily — Subfamily name from the consensus FASTA.
  • Assigned — Copies that passed all assignment criteria (unanimous 10/10 vote AND bitscore ≥ threshold).
  • TopN_Bitscore — Bitscore of the N-th best per-subfamily hit (N = min(10, count)); reference for the threshold.
  • Threshold — Cutoff applied: 0.45 × TopN_Bitscore × 100. Copies below this are unassigned.

Bitscore thresholds vs real consensus self-bits

The threshold is stored as integer bits×100; real self-bits are the raw ssearch36 bitscore of each consensus aligned against itself. The ratio shows how strict the threshold is relative to a perfect self-match (1.0 = perfect).

Column legend
  • Subfamily — Subfamily name.
  • Threshold (x100) — Bitscore cutoff used by step2 (stored as integer = bits × 100).
  • RealSelfBits — ssearch36 bitscore of the consensus aligned against itself (raw bitscore).
  • Threshold/Self — Threshold (in bits, divided back by 100) / RealSelfBits. Roughly the minimum fractional similarity to consensus a copy must reach.

Quality flags (CONFLICT / LEAK / OK)

Counts of merged genomic intervals per subfamily, grouped by sanity-check flag from step3_postprocess.sh. A high %CONFLICT means many intervals had hits from multiple subfamilies in the same locus.

Column legend
  • Subfamily — Subfamily name (winner of the merged interval).
  • Total — Number of merged genomic intervals labelled with this subfamily.
  • OK — Intervals with no conflict and no leak flag.
  • LEAK — Intervals where this subfamily 'leaked' a hit into an interval owned by a different subfamily.
  • CONFLICT — Intervals where multiple subfamilies had hits in the same merged region.
  • %CONFLICT — 100 × CONFLICT / Total.
